metadata.title: A Blank Is Not a No
metadata.bookend_exempt_reason: Course pitch film narrated by the student as herself: no composer cold open, no verdict card, and no Your Turn prompt — the assignment's seven questions take their place. The outro uses StudentTitleOutro, a local copy of ClaudeTitleOutro that renders the student's own handle, because the stock component hardcodes the instructor's handle and the assignment forbids the instructor's name, persona or credit line.

skin_warnings: BIDEA: palette=claude but the cold open is 'BrutalistHesitantWriter' — COLD OPEN LAW wants ClaudeComposerAsk
BOUT: palette=claude but the outro is 'StudentTitleOutro' — OUTRO LAW wants ClaudeTitleOutro

beats.narration_text: Hi. I'm Yudan Zhou, an Information Systems master's student, and this is the pitch for my final project — a portfolio piece for data analyst roles. The voice you are hearing is a synthetic voice reading my own script.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell bookend: one typed line and its correction, nothing else on screen.

show.event: The question types itself and one phrase is corrected

beats.narration_text: Three terms. Sponsorship means an employer filed paperwork so a foreign worker can stay. O.P.T. is the limited window a student gets to work after graduating. A blank record means the dataset matched no filing to that company — which is not a refusal.

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell bookend: three terms, one line each.

show.event: Three terms appear and settle

terms.meaning: An employer files so you can stay
A limited window to work after graduating
No matched filing — not a refusal

beats.narration_text: In one sentence: a job-search triage tool for international students. It sorts postings into apply, consider, or skip using public funding and sponsorship records — and when there is no record, it says so. Finished, it is a repository with a recipe, a Python tool, tests, and an evaluation log.

shot.visual_intent: Postings ride a conveyor into three trays, with a fourth tray set apart
shot.motion_claim: One posting peels off into a fourth tray marked no record

show.event: Postings enter on the conveyor
Three trays fill: apply, consider, skip
One posting peels off into a fourth tray set apart

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: belt, four trays and the repository box on cream; one idea, labels beside objects. Only underfill and clustering waived.

beats.narration_text: Twenty-seven thousand, eight hundred seventy-four companies have a funding date. Only one thousand, five hundred thirty-two have any H-1B approval on record. Only one hundred thirty-one of those raised money in the last two years. Funded and sponsoring barely overlap.

shot.visual_intent: A tall bar collapses twice, each time to a fraction of itself
shot.motion_claim: The bar shrinks from 27,874 to 1,532 to 131

show.event: A full-height bar stands at 27,874
It collapses to 1,532
It collapses again to 131

beats.narration_text: The bigger trap is the blank. Twenty-eight thousand, eight hundred twelve rows have no approval number at all. Only five say zero. A blank almost never means does not sponsor. It means nobody matched a record.

shot.visual_intent: An enormous stack of blank cards beside five small cards marked zero
shot.motion_claim: The blank stack keeps growing while the five stay five

show.event: Five small cards marked 0 sit alone
A stack of blank cards rises beside them and keeps rising

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: five zero cards against one blank stack; the empty space is the contrast being shown. Only underfill and clustering waived.

beats.narration_text: On October thirteenth I searched h1bdata dot info for Moloco, a company in my run. It returned a long table of filings: job titles, salaries, dates. Then I searched 123 See, a company my data has no record for. No table, no count, and nothing saying it found nothing. That blank is what a student reads as a no.

shot.visual_intent: Two identical search boxes: one returns a long table, the other returns nothing
shot.motion_claim: The right-hand box returns an empty frame where the table should be

show.event: Two identical search boxes appear
The left box fills with a long table
The right box returns an empty frame

beats.narration_text: My tool labels that blank, keeps the company out of the ranking, and moves it to my networking list with a question to ask a person. It does not save lookup time. It stops a student throwing away most of the market.

shot.visual_intent: A blank card is lifted off the ranking conveyor and set into a separate tray
shot.motion_claim: The blank card leaves the ranking and lands under a question mark

show.event: A blank card rides toward the ranking
It is lifted clear of the ranking
It lands in a tray with a question bubble

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one card leaves the ranking for the network tray. Only underfill and clustering waived.

beats.narration_text: The reader I am pitching to is a hiring manager for a data analyst role. In sixty seconds they clone the repository, run one command, and see a shortlist where every number carries a tag. Record means a data file produced it. Your input means I chose it.

shot.visual_intent: One command runs and a shortlist appears, each number wearing a small tag
shot.motion_claim: Tags attach themselves to each number as the list lands

show.event: A single command runs
A shortlist lands
A tag attaches to each number

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one command and one shortlist sheet. Only underfill and clustering waived.

beats.narration_text: What it shows is source grounding and verification. Eleven tests exist, and one checks those tags rather than the arithmetic. On October twelfth a teaching assistant reviewing the recipe wrote: you never turn a blank into a no.

shot.visual_intent: A magnifier passes over the tags; a check mark lands beside a list of tests
shot.motion_claim: The magnifier stops on a tag and a check appears

show.event: A magnifier moves across the tagged numbers
It stops on one tag
A check lands beside a short list of tests

beats.narration_text: The honest split. Today: a recipe, a Python prototype, eleven tests. Still to come: the corrected status, a written reason for every assumption, a sensitivity check, a test set with known answers, and a failure analysis.

shot.visual_intent: Two shelves side by side: one holds solid objects, the other holds dashed outlines
shot.motion_claim: Solid items land on the left shelf; dashed outlines appear on the right

show.event: Two empty shelves appear
Solid objects land on the left shelf
Dashed outlines appear on the right shelf

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: two shelves, solid vs dashed items. Only underfill and clustering waived.

beats.narration_text: One thing it will deliberately never do: say a company does not sponsor, except the five whose record shows a zero. First I will make the two review fixes run — status back to draft, and a written reason behind every placeholder number. You will know it ran when the tests pass and no number in the report says placeholder.

shot.visual_intent: A gate that opens only for a card carrying a record; a flag drops on two items
shot.motion_claim: A blank card is turned back at the gate while a record card passes

show.event: A card carrying a record passes the gate
A blank card is turned back
A flag drops onto two items on a short list

beats.narration_text: The risk is that numbers I choose outweigh the records I look up. In my own run one company had five hundred sixty-four approvals and still scored zero, because of one hand-entered demo value. This pitch's own first draft had four statements that did not match my files — an AI review caught them. So I will add a sensitivity check that moves each assumption and counts how many decisions flip.

shot.visual_intent: A balance where one small hand-written tile outweighs a tall stack of record cards
shot.motion_claim: The single tile drops and the tall stack lifts

show.event: A tall stack of record cards sits on one pan
One small hand-written tile drops onto the other pan
The tall stack lifts

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: one balance with a record stack and one tile; spacing kept so the stacked cards do not read as overlapping text (Gate T). Only underfill and clustering waived.

beats.narration_text: Why this project? A mix. The domain is mine — I am the person it is built for, and the judgment calls are mine. The code was written with an AI assistant under my direction. New to me: writing and testing code myself, a test set with known answers, and sensitivity analysis.

shot.visual_intent: Two piles build up side by side, one solid and one still being assembled
shot.motion_claim: Items sort themselves into the two piles

show.event: Two empty areas appear
Items sort into a solid pile
Items sort into a half-built pile

qc.sparse_reason: Show-tell: two platforms, have vs learning. Only underfill and clustering waived.

beats.narration_text: A Blank Is Not a No. I'm Yudan Zhou. Thanks for watching.
